title: chrysanthemum nodosum
intro: Chrysanthemum nodosum, commonly known as Tiepao or Purple Chrysanthemum, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum nodosum include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral agent, as well as having sedative and diuretic properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
